purpose: Compile multiple explicit prompt invocations into one deterministic execution contract without wholesale prompt inclusion, duplicate ownership, probabilistic tie-breaking, or additive authority.

terminology.invocation: Request evaluation of a prompt's task-applicable facets. Invocation does not require using every clause of the prompt.
terminology.projection: The subset of one prompt's declared invocation facets relevant to the current typed task facets.
terminology.residual: A prompt's projected facets after already-satisfied canonical overlap is removed.
terminology.coherence: A composition is coherent only when overlapping facets have one explicit canonicalization, ordering, or constraining rule.
terminology.pushback: A deterministic route change produced by contract facts, not model preference.

relation_kinds.DISJOINT: Projected facet sets do not intersect. They commute unless an explicit task dependency orders them.
relation_kinds.DUPLICATE: The same semantic contribution is supplied more than once. Keep one canonical owner and suppress duplicates.
relation_kinds.ORDERED_OVERLAP: The prompts legitimately share a facet, but one decision/artifact must precede and feed the downstream residual.
relation_kinds.CONSTRAINING_OVERLAP: One invocation contributes a guardrail or proof constraint over another. The constraint remains monotone and cannot grant authority.
relation_kinds.CONFLICT: The same facet has incompatible unresolved owners or instructions. Composition fails closed.

mathematical_model.residualization: R_i = A_i \ C_i, where C_i is the already-canonicalized applicable overlap supplied by an accepted upstream owner/artifact.
mathematical_model.duplicate_union: The composed procedure is the union of residual contributions plus one canonical copy of each shared invariant.
mathematical_model.authority_source_invariant: Invocation contributes no authority. For every contemplated action a, effective_authority(a) = external_task_authority(a) ∧ repository_policy(a) ∧ safety_policy(a) ∧ verified_capability(a) ∧ selected_owner_scope(a).
mathematical_model.authority_divergence_guard: For every prompt node v, A_out(v) \ (A_in(v) ∪ A_external) MUST be empty. A prompt may route or narrow authority; it may not create it.
mathematical_model.routing_cycle_guard: A closed prompt-routing cycle with no changed evidence, proof floor, artifact identity, or task state is invalid no-progress circulation and MUST fail rather than loop.
mathematical_model.note: This is set algebra plus graph ordering. Vector-space orthogonality, divergence, and curl are analogies until a typed numerical field is defined.
mathematical_model.prerequisite_rule: Derived prerequisites may expand execution only from an explicit routing rule, and each injected prompt is still projected against task facets; the composer MUST NOT invent unrelated facets.

composition_rules: Project before composing: invoked prompts contribute only facets present in task_facets.
Empty projection means INVOKED_NO_APPLICABLE_RESIDUAL, not forced use.
Applicable negative constraints and forbidden scopes are monotone unless superseded by a higher-precedence platform/repository rule.
If overlapping projected facets lack an explicit relation, return INCOHERENT_INVOCATION.
A pair rule applies only to its declared shared_facets; any additional overlap is unresolved and MUST fail closed until explicitly classified.
If precedence edges cannot be topologically linearized, return INCOHERENT_INVOCATION.
Disjoint prompts are canonically tie-broken by numeric prompt id so equivalent invocation sets compile reproducibly.

A user-selected prompt may be pushed back to a prerequisite or successor only when typed task facets and an explicit routing rule require it. Existing canonical fallback authority must not be silently stolen by the composer.
Prompt composition MUST NOT widen mutation, merge, deployment, secret, destructive, or live-target authority.

pair_rules.ordering_rule: When the task explicitly requires planning.factor, P04 owns that factoring before P05 packing. Otherwise P05 consumes an ACCEPTED_CURRENT P04 artifact when present, and if no usable P04 artifact exists P05 retains its canonical bounded recovery factoring authority.

lifecycle_edges.reason: implementation precedes live proof of that implementation
prior-art research narrows an implementation target before execution when explicitly invoked

p97_prior_art.mechanic: Evaluate independent policies, deny if any forbid matches, otherwise allow only if a permit matches; constraints cannot be canceled by a permit.
Overlapping trait implementations are incoherent when the same instance can satisfy both.
Python's C3 MRO contract preserves local precedence and monotonicity and rejects inconsistent linearizations.
Module definitions merge by typed rules with explicit override and order priorities rather than implicit last-writer wins.

proof_ceiling: Deterministic repository/static composition semantics and executable contract tests on an exact candidate head. Provider integration and downstream model/UI consumer wiring remain separate proof gates.
